_meta.title: arena.ai sweep Session 22 (May 23-26) — Qwen3.7-Max build + Recraft v4.1 + image/video model registry expansion
_meta.context: User asked for leaderboard refresh after Session 21 (May 23). arena.ai changelog (May 22 + May 25) added recraft-v4.1-pro / recraft-v4.1-utility-pro (Text-to-Image) + qwen3.7-max-20260517 (Code/WebDev arena). Full Playwright snapshots of arena.ai/leaderboard/code (WebDev) and /text-to-image leaderboards (top 34 each). Massive image-gen model registry gap revealed — 18 unique image-gen models present on arena but absent from DB (Flux 2 family, Bytedance Seedream variants, Tencent Hunyuan Image, Google Imagen Ultra/4.0, Reve v1.5, Qwen Image variants, gpt-image-1 vintage, etc.). This session focuses on the May-22+May-25 changelog targets PLUS a representative subset of top-ranked image-gen models that arena lists. WebDev arena Qwen3.7-Max-20260517 entered at rank #4 (1541 Elo) — a Preliminary score that puts the new build ahead of Opus 4.6 (1538) and behind only Opus 4.7 family + Opus 4.6 Thinking.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. All Elo + vote-count values verbatim from arena.ai May 26 2026 snapshot. Preliminary tags noted in _note. For Qwen3.7-Max-20260517 the build-date suffix is preserved as a distinct model ID (Alibaba publishes dated builds independently). Image-gen models registered with canonical vendor/model-name IDs; pricing tier qualifiers (medium/pro/utility-pro/high-fidelity) tracked. Scores in this batch are Elo type — same benchmark IDs as Session 21 (arena_webdev_elo + arena_text_to_image_elo).
